It provides various wafer fabrication processes, such as processes to manufacture complementary metal- oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, embedded memory, bipolar CMOS mixed-signal, and others. The company also involved in providing customer and engineering support services; manufacturing of masks; investment in technology start-up companies; research, designing, developing, manufacturing, packaging, testing, and sale of color filters; and investment activities. Its products are used in high performance computing, smartphones, Internet of things, automotive, and digital consumer electronics. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

companyProfile.description: Parker-Hannifin Corporation è impegnata nella produzione e vendita di tecnologie e sistemi di movimento e controllo per i mercati aerospaziale e della difesa, di impianti e industriali, dei trasporti, fuoristrada, dell'energia, HVAC e della refrigerazione in Nord America, EMEA, Asia Pacifico e America Latina. L'azienda fornisce inoltre prodotti da utilizzare in programmi di cellule e motori commerciali e di difesa, quali avionica, sistemi di frenatura elettrici e idraulici, energia elettrica, attuatori elettromeccanici, sistemi e componenti di scarico dei motori, rilevamento e soppressione di incendi, sistemi di controllo di volo, trasporto di fluidi, sistemi e componenti di carburante, sistemi di inserimento di serbatoi di carburante, pompe e motori idraulici, valvole e attuatori idraulici, componenti pneumatici, guarnizioni, sensori e prodotti di gestione termica. L'azienda vende i suoi prodotti a produttori di apparecchiature originali, distributori e addetti alla vendita diretta. Parker-Hannifin Corporation è stata fondata nel 1917 e ha sede a Cleveland, Ohio.

profile.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, packages, tests, and sells integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices in Taiwan, China, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Japan, the United States, and internationally. It provides various wafer fabrication processes, such as processes to manufacture complementary metal- oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, embedded memory, bipolar CMOS mixed-signal, and others. The company also involved in providing customer and engineering support services; manufacturing of masks; investment in technology start-up companies; research, designing, developing, manufacturing, packaging, testing, and sale of color filters; and investment activities. Its products are used in high performance computing, smartphones, Internet of things, automotive, and digital consumer electronics. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
